description: Codex alone (hook trusted): a lock entry of the first design (#41: block, keyed AGENTS.md) whose source cannot be resolved keeps its section, read from the old rules block in ~/.codex/AGENTS.md, now in ~/.codex/skilletor-rules.md – the entry rewritten under that file name, silently; a section edited by hand in the rules file is overwritten from its source and named; the old block in AGENTS.md becomes the pointer, the user's text kept. check and status after; a resync keeps the migrated section and overwrites nothing.
